_readme: Early-era substitutes for the 2012-2016 /portfolio listing, which only the Internet Archive holds and which was not read (machine-wide cooldown through the whole run, re-armed at 23:43 EDT for two hours). Two independent first-party snapshots, read 2026-09-30. (1) Arquivo.pt, the Portuguese web archive, crawled speedinvest.com on 2014-11-23 (CDX: https://arquivo.pt/wayback/cdx?url=speedinvest.com/*&output=json): the home page, /team/, /idea/, /newsletter/ and the post feed, not /portfolio/. The team page prints each partner's own 'Portfolio:' line. (2) The 35 Common Crawl captures of the home page from 2012 to 2016 (data/filings/commoncrawl/speedinvest) link the featured portfolio posts at /blog/portfolio/<slug>/. Every name from both is a base row, a merged duplicate or a recorded exclusion. Raw pages: data/filings/site-raw/speedinvest/arquivo/ (untracked).
